verdict.rationale: Kick's docs say its AI automatically categorizes synced transactions, about 97% on the first pass, and 'learns from your changes'. Low-confidence items are left for manual review, and user rules can override the AI. This covers automatic categorization that adapts to user corrections. Missing for 10: detail on how learning from corrections works, explicit confirmation that CSV/PDF-imported transactions go through the same AI categorization, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get automatic categorization suggestions for imported transactions that learn from my corrections

citations.quote: Kick automatically categorizes your transactions and learns from your changes.
When Kick's confidence is low, the transaction is left uncategorized for you to review manually
the AI categorizes approximately 97% of them on the first pass - things like meals, software subscriptions, payroll, rent, and revenue.
Upload PDF bank statements or CSVs for institutions not supported by Plaid, or to backfill historical data.
